melbfoot: Explore Hourly Pedestrian Counts in Melbourne

Source: R/melbfoot-package.R
melbfoot-package.Rd

Provides hourly pedestrian counts from the City of Melbourne Pedestrian Counting System, summarised by sensor, year, day type and hour of day. Includes helper functions to build typical-day profiles and to measure how foot traffic changed relative to a baseline year, and a 'shiny' app that helps business owners and event planners compare locations and years.
